name: The Handy
summary: Precision Wi-Fi + Bluetooth linear stroker engineered for high-speed VR video synchronization, open `.funscript` scripting, and hands-free mount rigs.
ranking_rationale: Undisputed gold standard for interactive VR scenes and community funscripts—nothing else matches its stroke speed, responsiveness, and open Wi-Fi API.

pricing.free_tier: Handyverse web player & HandyFeeling scripts included
pricing.notes: Check official store for current bundle pricing; additional sleeves and hands-free mounts sold separately.

pros: Blistering linear stroke speed with millimeter-accurate VR timecode sync
Open Wi-Fi API works natively with DeoVR, SexLikeReal, HereSphere, and Intiface
True open `.funscript` ecosystem with thousands of synced community videos
Accepts aftermarket sleeves via its velcro-band carrier
cons: Must plug into AC wall power (no internal battery)
Fast reciprocating motor is noticeably loud without headphones
True hands-free VR bliss almost requires buying a desk mount accessory

image.alt: The Handy logo and brand card

facts.value: Supports DeoVR, SLR Interactive, HereSphere, Intiface, and .funscript
Wall-powered DC adapter for zero torque sag during high-speed strokes
